sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.q: A geometric figure scaled by factor $k = 2$ has an original side length of $7\mathrm{\ cm}$. What is the corresponding image length? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $14\mathrm{\ cm}$. Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $7 \times 2 = 14\mathrm{\ cm}$.
questions.explanation: Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $7 \times 2 = 14\mathrm{\ cm}$.

questions.q: On the coordinate plane, a line with slope $m = 3$ passes through $(0, 6)$. What is its $y$-coordinate when $x = 1$? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $9$. Substituting $x = 1$ into $y = 3x + 6$ gives $y = 3(1) + 6 = 9$.
questions.explanation: Substituting $x = 1$ into $y = 3x + 6$ gives $y = 3(1) + 6 = 9$.

questions.q: In $\Delta  ABC$ studying parallel lines and transversals, $m\angle A = 53^\circ$ and $m\angle B = 52^\circ$. What is $m\angle C$? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $75^\circ$. Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (53^\circ + 52^\circ) = 75^\circ$.
questions.explanation: Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (53^\circ + 52^\circ) = 75^\circ$.

questions.q: Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 7x + 6 = 0$.
questions.answer: Factoring $(x - 1)(x - 6) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 1$ and $x = 6$.
